items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

ctx.x: Oh great, so he saw you with—

He saw us both having some nice things and seeing us do what he had in mind all through. He was a wonderful guy. I remember I took Ziggy Elman’s place, that was the Herd just before he went in the service, and I took his place with Tommy Dorsey’s band, and Sy Oliver was writing for the band. And at the Hotel Sherman they changed the band every two weeks, another name band would come in. And he knew my father, and he would say, “Tony, did you bring some wine with you?” Because he loved my father’s wine. My father…
You started on the French horn? Is that correct?
